text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One weekend, Gold Ship shows up out
of
nowhere and drags me to the movie
theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We happen to run into Mejiro McQueen
while
we're there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hiii-de-ho! To which movie shall we go?
I'll give
you 10,800 seconds to decide,
so think fast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I should hope deciding won't take us
three
hours... And would you please
keep your voice
down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer, but might you
purchase some
popcorn? The largest size
they have, if you
please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That ought to keep Gold Ship
preoccupied until
the film is over.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You know it! We watch movies together
all the
time. Mac loves me so much, she
just can't stay
away! ♪
choice_data_list: You're used to it, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can't stay away? You're the one who keeps sneaking up on me unannounced!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, just last time you appeared out of
nowhere
in the empty seat beside me! I
nearly shrieked!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen, you can't do that! Every
movie
lover has to follow the golden
rule:

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No noise until the credits roll!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Argh, you are impossible!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Anyways, we'd better pick a flick!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We've got the heartwarming sports movie, Shape Up, Ebisu High! Or the pulse-pounding action romp, JAM: The Last Cartridge! What'll it be?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An athlete's coming-of-age story or an

adrenaline-laced thrill ride? H-how can
we ever
decide?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see both, do you? But you can't
have your cake and eat it too! Well, not
unless you've
mastered the shadow
clone jutsu, like me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Okay, your call, Trainer. What'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us have a blast watching Shape Up, Ebisu High.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The story of a ragtag sumo club's climb
from the
bottom of the barrel to the top
of the league gets
us all inspired.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why, that was marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Especially when the main character beat that instructor... He started out a lazy glutton, but he grew so much... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho? Are those tears I spy, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: O-of course not! I'm not crying!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm a proud Umamusume of the Mejiro
family! I
would never be so improper as
t—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bah! Mejiro schmejiro. If you wanna let it
out, let
it out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You felt it too, right? Didn't it pluck at
your
heartstrings every time the hero got
back up?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Those moments that bring a tear to the
eye...
That's what it's all about! A life
without that
would be a snoozefest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I admit it! That movie touched me to the core! I... I was deeply moved! ...Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's perfect! Very nice! Now, look
right into the
camera!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How dare you! Turn that off right this
instant!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Gotta run! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What nerve!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I don't know why I put up with
her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us have a blast watching JAM: The Last Cartridge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The nonstop thrills have our palms
sweating, and the over-the-top action
keeps us on the edge of
our seats from
start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Pant... Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I... can't... take it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Erm... Gold Ship? Pardon me, but you
seem to be
breathing rather heavily.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That leap from the forty-eighth story!
That midair throwing knife kick! That
sick skateboard grind
down the roller
coaster!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
GAAAH! I'm so fired up! Action movies
rock!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Shhh! Please! Keep your voice down!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: LET'S GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: G-Gold Ship?! Hey! Come back here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no telling what an
adrenaline-fueled Gold
Ship might do!
Mejiro McQueen and I race after
her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship! Oh, where in the world has
she run off
to?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! Thief! That man stole my purse!
Somebody
stop him!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A thief?!

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Hey, you! Outta my way!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Never fear! Action hero Golshi is here,
fresh off a
training course that spanned
twenty star systems!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: YOU SHALL NOT PASS! HI-YAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wha-Pow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... You knocked him flat
on his
back. There really is no stopping
you sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now that blew the cobwebs away!
Action
movies are awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship grins from ear to ear as the
onlookers
applaud her skills.
